id./param/scenario/cs/a_170_cs_090.pack|cs_: "Aha! This should be very useful indeed! It is the great mage's account of how he imprisoned the witch. Let's see now...
"'The magick of the sorceress was passing strong. Even with all my energies, I could neither conquer nor constrain her.
"'And so I conspired with a great enchanted beast, that by its incorporation of a piece of her magick, I might subdue her.
"'Thereupon was the witch imprisoned in a book in the Library. As for the beast, it haunteth the Hekswood to this day...'
"I see... So even the greatest mage of the Age of Heroes needed a magical creature's help to seal the witch away...
"'A great enchanted beast'? You met one in the Hekswood, the thing that was supposed to be the witch's pet!
"...Oh? Tell me, what did this creature look like?
"Hmm... A rounded, white body with a golden mane... Two pointed tusks jutting from an enormous jaw...
"How can you have been so foolish? The monster you defeated was the very one keeping the witch's powers sealed away!
"It's not his fault! Queen Frysabel told us it was on the witch's side! She said it guarded her against intruders!
"Is this true? But why would Her Majesty say such a thing...?
"Hold on, I'm sure I've seen that symbol before. Wasn't it on the front of the book the Queen was reading?
"This? Why, this is the Sorcerer's Seal. It is a ward placed on all the forbidden books of the great library.
"So the book the Queen was reading was forbidden... Wait, what if it was the book the witch was sealed in? What if...?
"We need to go back to Sniflheim and talk to the Queen. I've got a feeling there's some funny business afoot!
